name: Katarzyna Rozdrażewska

events.note: Holding the lordship and a life interest in all her husband's goods; still party in 1763.

events.type: Held Trąbczyn for life as widow
events.note: Paweł's widow, lady of his estates by dower and life interest (domina reformatoria et advitalitialis); dead by January 1768.

notes: Daughter of Karol Rozdrażewski and Joanna Marszłynowna; widow of Aleksander Poniński, łowczy of Wschowa (the decree of 1784, p. 0167_b). Her inscription of 40,000 złp of 1745 was made to her as a future husband's wife, so the marriage with Paweł is after 1745.
